subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw make same-agent owner-scoped live transcript hits visible when the combined session store has no entry, while cross-agent and basename-only misses remain closed?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive session-history visibility choice: the code shape is narrow, but the behavior intentionally changes what existing store-missing live transcript hits can reveal after upgrade.

options.title: Accept scoped fallback
options.body: Approve this narrow same-agent fallback as intended behavior because the patch keeps cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits fail-closed.

options.title: Request gateway replay proof
options.body: Require a live gateway memory_search or memory-wiki replay with refreshed session indexing before accepting the visibility change.

options.title: Pause for broader identity policy
options.body: Hold this PR under the broader session-recall work if store-missing live transcripts should remain hidden until the identity contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fallback
recommendation.body: Approve this narrow same-agent fallback as intended behavior because the patch keeps cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged memory/QMD session identity work makes jalehman the strongest code-history routing candidate for this policy choice.
